verdict.rationale: Insomnia documents a Collection Runner that executes multiple requests in order and "automatically test[s] multiple requests in your collections." After-response scripting provides test logic. The Inso CLI automates these tests and returns exit codes that pass or fail a CI workflow. missing for 10: documentation of the pass/fail results report itself (per-test results view or exportable report format), explicit description of assertions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
